scope: Mock HTMLMediaElement routing/time synchronization. Actual MP3 files were not provided; this is not an audible waveform test.

results.name: Seven MP3 combat pools plus one embedded click pool are created
Persian/space-containing names are URI encoded at assignment
Button click is a short media sample, not a combat synthesizer
MISSILE_LAUNCHED/ballistic maps to launch
INTERCEPTOR_LAUNCHED/sam maps to sam
INTERCEPTOR_LAUNCHED/aaa maps to aaa
MISSILE_INTERCEPTED/fighter maps to intercept
MISSILE_IMPACT/drone maps to explosion
AIRCRAFT_LAUNCHED/patrol maps to takeoff
Strike starts from clip second zero
Flyby is at 6.98 seconds just before impact
Impact aligns to clip second seven
Pause freezes the file sound with the game
Fast forward uses simulation playback rate
Background tab pauses ongoing sound
Intercepted strike cancels its scheduled explosion file
Fighter loss after release does not cancel its independent missile
One gun shot uses a short file slice instead of a sustained burst
Missing MP3 becomes silent unavailable state with no synthesis
Exit stops every audio voice
